description: This file is the main entry point for a Flutter application. It defines the main widget tree, including the app's theme, home page, and basic UI components such as AppBar, Text, and CircularProgressIndicator.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: A stateless widget that sets up the application's theme and initial home page.

classes.name: MyHomePage
classes.description: A stateful widget representing the main page with a title parameter.

classes.name: _MyHomePageState
classes.description: The state object for MyHomePage that builds the UI, including AppBar and Body with a loading indicator.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The entry point for the Flutter application that calls runApp with MyApp.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for MyApp, MyHomePage, and _MyHomePageState.
